forgotten_ones.name: Star Wars: Forgotten Ones
forgotten_ones.description: A crew of outcasts awakens from cryo-stasis aboard a derelict vessel. In a galaxy that has moved on, they must find their place among the stars or be consumed by the shadows of their past. They face the challenges of a new era while uncovering the mystery of their abandonment.
